## Community and university service

- Volunteer, organization committee of the International Japan-Egypt Conference on Electronics, Communications and Computers (JEC-ECC 2012).
- Volunteer, E-JUST Graduate Student Association.
- Volunteer, organization committee of the 25th National Radio Science Conference (NRSC 2008).

## Professional engagement

I contribute to the research community through peer review and conference participation in wireless communications, signal processing, networking, and related engineering fields.

## Awards and travel support

Selected support includes a five-year Ministry of Higher Education scholarship for MSc and PhD study at E-JUST, travel grants for research presentations in Japan, Austria, France, and Italy, and a First in Row award from Tanta University.
